summary: The Constitution requires a count of the population within every term of ten years.
realLife: Article I, Section 2 of the Constitution requires an enumeration of the population within every subsequent term of ten years, which the Census Bureau carries out.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, About the Decennial Census of Population and Housing: https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial-census/about.html
inGame: the people and electorate modules' century history rows, read by the loading screen's progress steps for history and the opening (loading-steps.history).

turns.what: A census year is skipped and the counts carry over.
turns.writesBack: a gap in the population rows

turns.what: A count is made but disputed, and the old numbers stand for a while.
turns.writesBack: two sets of population rows for the same year
